clue.text: Die of cold

parts.note: a die is a small cube used in games, so a cube-shaped piece made of frozen water is a die of cold

explanation.surface: Someone perishes from the freezing weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Die' reads as the verb to perish, but it is the noun: a gaming die is a cube.
explanation.definitionFit: A small frozen block for drinks is cube-shaped, like a gaming die made of cold stuff.

clue.text: Works decoratively on intricate corset with check lining

indicators.note: lining means the second piece sits inside the first, as a lining sits inside a garment
intricate means complicated and tangled, so the letters of corset are rearranged

parts.note: CH is the chess notation abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: A seamstress embellishes a complicated corset with a chequered lining.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is the chess shorthand for check; 'on' is just a link word joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Crochet is a decorative needlework; someone doing it works decoratively with a hooked needle.

clue.text: Courtsey shown by Greek character to lady by railway

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
Val is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A gentleman from Greece is polite to a woman by the train line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Courtsey' is printed with its letters slipped; it is meant as courtesy.
explanation.definitionFit: Chivalry is gallant, courteous behaviour, especially towards women.

clue.text: Covers punts, for example

parts.note: read as a noun phrase: buildings that shelter small river craft such as punts

explanation.surface: Something conceals bets, such as wagers on horses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Covers' looks like a verb and 'punts' like bets, but these are shelters for flat-bottomed river boats.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheds by the water that house rowing craft and punts are buildings for vessels.

clue.text: Wine tastier than some

indicators.note: some means only part of the following word is taken, a run of its letters

explanation.surface: A wine that tastes better than certain others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes part of 'tastier': t-ASTI-er; 'than' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont.

clue.text: Rush wildly through one's life

definitions.meaning: to hurtle along out of control
a person's working life or progress through life

explanation.definitionFit: Career is both a verb for hurtling headlong and a noun for one's life course or profession.

clue.text: Thank you for the poets' coats

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you
bards are poets

explanation.surface: Gratitude expressed for the garments worn by poets.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is British slang for 'thank you'.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabards are sleeveless tunics or coats, once worn by heralds over armour.

clue.text: Fevered Al seems to have spots

indicators.note: fevered means agitated and disordered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A feverish man called Al looks like he has a rash.
explanation.definitionFit: Measles is an illness known for its red rash, so it is a disease of spots.

clue.text: Pa ceased to be prepared for adventure

indicators.note: prepared means made up or reworked, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Father stopped in order to get ready for a daring trip.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a reckless adventure or daring exploit.

clue.text: Rightly reasoning that a piece of wood has little dietary value

parts.note: a log is a piece of wood
one calorie, written 1 CAL, is a tiny food value; the figure one becomes I

explanation.surface: Sound logic says a bit of timber is almost worthless as food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little dietary value' is 1 cal, a single calorie, with the 1 read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: Logical means reasoning soundly and correctly.

clue.text: Sidney cares about motorcycle attachments

parts.note: Sid is the short form of the name Sidney

indicators.note: about means around or in disorder, so the letters of cares are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sidney looks after the extra seats on motorbikes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the anagram signal, not a word meaning concerning; the surface makes Sidney the one who cares.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidecars are passenger cars fixed to the side of motorcycles.

clue.text: Eve strode out with dock worker

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman named Eve marched off accompanied by a docker.
explanation.definitionFit: A stevedore loads and unloads ships at the docks.

clue.text: Covering Southern shrub land

parts.note: a heath is open land covered in shrubs like heather

explanation.surface: Ground cover over moorland in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheath is a close-fitting cover, as for a blade.

clue.text: Span a superior crossing

definitions.meaning: to span is to bridge or stretch across
a crossing placed above another route, as a road over a railway

explanation.definitionFit: An overbridge is a bridge carrying a road over a railway or another road, a span.

clue.text: Putting an end to getting divorced

definitions.meaning: to break up a meeting is to bring it to an end

explanation.definitionFit: Breaking up means both ending something and a couple splitting, as in a divorce.

clue.text: On the street I run activity

parts.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A runner on the road describes taking exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A stir is a bustle or commotion, a burst of activity.

clue.text: Before today agreed territory for the first lady

parts.note: yes is a word of agreement
TER is an abbreviation for territory
Eve is the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: Earlier, land was signed over to the President's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first lady' looks like a President's wife, but is Eve, the first woman in Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: Yestereve is an old poetic word for yesterday evening, a time before today.

clue.text: Courted a striking teacher

indicators.note: striking means hitting out, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman wooed a teacher who was on strike.
explanation.definitionFit: An educator is one who teaches or instructs.

clue.text: Weather conditions relevant to 151 friends

parts.note: in Roman numerals C is 100, L is 50 and I is 1, making 151
mates are friends

explanation.surface: Weather is a topic of interest to some group of pals.
explanation.definitionFit: Climates are the prevailing weather conditions of regions.

clue.text: Vehicle left here

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: This is where the car was parked.
explanation.definitionFit: A carport is an open-sided shelter where a car is left.

clue.text: CHHHCHHOH — hic!

parts.note: the string spells out the atoms of drinking alcohol, carbon and hydrogen around an OH group, and the hiccup marks the drunkenness it causes

explanation.surface: A chemical formula followed by a drunken hiccup.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters list the atoms of the molecule written CH3CH2OH.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethanol, formula CH3CH2OH, is the alcohol in drinks that causes hiccups.

clue.text: Idiot lied regularly to obtain small portion

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken, at even intervals

explanation.surface: A fool told fibs to get a little share.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th letters of IDIOT LIED.
explanation.definitionFit: A dole is a portion doled out, a small share given in charity.

clue.text: Minor tremor as a result of bombshell

parts.note: after can mean following from, as a consequence of
a bombshell is a shock

explanation.surface: A small quake follows shocking news.
explanation.definitionFit: An aftershock is a smaller tremor that follows a main earthquake.

clue.text: Current, we hear, could be gettin' higher by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it signals that a word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: getting higher is rising or raising, here with the g dropped as in gettin'

explanation.surface: Electric power sounds like it might be rising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current, we hear' is the dried fruit currant, which a raisin resembles; the dropped g of gettin' turns raising into raisin'.
explanation.definitionFit: A currant is a small dried grape, much as a raisin is, so one could pass for the other.

clue.text: Arrival of revenue

definitions.meaning: an archaic sense: a coming in, an entrance

explanation.definitionFit: Income literally means a coming in, and is also money earned as revenue.

clue.text: I reshape eccentric self-righteous person

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to remake their odd self.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pharisee, from the Jewish sect in the Gospels, means a self-righteous hypocrite.

clue.text: Point to the right

definitions.meaning: on a conventional map, the right-hand side faces this direction

explanation.definitionFit: East is a cardinal compass point and lies to the right on a north-up map.

clue.text: Keep moving the Italian through a doorway

indicators.note: through means the second piece runs inside the first

parts.note: a gate is an entrance or doorway
ITA is an abbreviation for Italian

explanation.surface: The Italian is told to keep walking through the entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: To agitate is to stir or shake, keeping something moving.

clue.text: Bed accommodating Master that is most spacious

indicators.note: accommodating means holding within, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: a roost is a bird's resting place, a bed
M is an abbreviation for master, as in MA
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: The master bed is the largest one.
explanation.definitionFit: Roomiest is the superlative of roomy, meaning having most space.

clue.text: Crush the work of the media

parts.note: OP abbreviates opus, a work
the press is the news media

explanation.surface: The press squeezes people with its work.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppress is to crush or keep down by force.
